indicator_name: Energy balance of Kazakhstan (fuels × flows), terajoules
methodology: BNS publication 19275, national, 2021 onward. Item «<fuel>.<flow>», fuel TOTAL = «Всего». Flows: S1.* supply (production, imports, exports with a minus sign, bunkers, stocks, total primary energy supply), TRANSFORM_IN/OUT.* by plant type, ENERGY_OWN_USE.*, S2.* losses and availability, FINAL_ENERGY[.INDUSTRY/.TRANSPORT/.OTHER].*, FINAL_NON_ENERGY.*. The 2021 edition splits some fuels differently (crude oil and condensate apart, electricity by source).
